method: The assistant selected every click coordinate from actual screenshots. Unchanged BrowserEngine and CatalogDB recorded manual marks and network. Acceptance was assessed from visible feature awards, balance changes, and response fields, not parser state. No automatic candidate discovery or recognition was used.
coordinate_system: Screenshot-normalized x,y, each tied to its before screenshot. Coordinates are observations for these layouts, not universal game locators.
